provenance.asset_description: The standard cover for Troubles in Grayce, featuring dynamic art of Seoni, iconic Varisian human sorcerer, and Amiri, iconic Kellid human barbarian, swinging sword and casting spells across each other at two gargoyles in mid flight outside a stone castle in the middle of a storm.
